Description:
Unlock the wonders of geology with this all-in-one educational rock, mineral, and gemstone collection set perfect for explorers of all ages! This bundle includes four unique kits: the Klutz Maker Lab 'Rocks, Gems & Geodes' STEM Kit (36 identified specimens plus crystal geode project and activity book), a K12 Advanced Rock & Mineral Collection (36 samples with guide), a Science Tech Rock Tumbler Refill Kit (grit, rough stones, and instructions), and an Oliver Mining Co. Pay Dirt (3 lb. bag with assorted stones and mineral specimen). Each set presents a vibrant assortment of real rocks and minerals, curated for hands-on discovery and learning. Ideal for classrooms, homeschoolers, or collectors, these kits provide hours of interactive fun polish, identify, and display your unique finds while developing scientific curiosity. Materials are safe, clearly labeled, and include detailed guides for an engaging educational experience. Purchase with confidence for a memorable, STEM-enriched gift or classroom resource.
